blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around West Central

items.t: Municipality: City of Maple Ridge, BC. SnapStats lists "West Central" as a sub-area under the community Maple Ridge.
Boundaries: the City publishes no boundary for the MLS "West Central" sub-area: UNVERIFIED as an official boundary.
Nearby areas: Southwest Maple Ridge (Hammond / Port Hammond) to the southwest, East Central and the Town Centre to the east, and Pitt Meadows across the municipal boundary to the west.

Transit: Maple Meadows Station (20010 Dunn Ave) serves the west side and Port Haney Station (22300 River Road) sits at the east edge of the wider west side; West Coast Express trains run weekdays between Waterfront and Mission City. Haney Place Exchange is in the Town Centre to the east (routes include the R3, 701, 733, 741, 743, 744, 745, 746, 748, 749 and 791; the R3 runs Coquitlam Central Station to Haney Place). Which of those routes run on West Central streets was not re-verified route by route: UNVERIFIED.

Services: no City recreation centre and no library branch sits in West Central — Maple Ridge Leisure Centre, 11925 Haney Place, and Maple Ridge Public Library, 130 – 22470 Dewdney Trunk Road, are both in the Town Centre to the east. A shopping centre physically inside West Central was not confirmed on an official source: UNVERIFIED; the nearest centre is the Town Centre, centred on Haney Place Mall, 11900 Haney Place. Ridge Meadows Hospital, 11666 Laity Street, is the community hospital with 24/7 emergency care; the Ridge Meadows Urgent and Primary Care Centre is at 121 – 11900 Haney Place, open 7 days a week, 9:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in West Central

items.t: Floodplain and escarpment: the Fraser River flood construction level is 6.7 m geodetic (including freeboard), a covenant on title identifies construction in the floodplain, no habitable floor space may be located below the flood construction level on affected lots, and Zoning Bylaw s. 402.8(h) prohibits rental accommodation (suites) on floodplain properties; the Fraser River Escarpment policy area's east boundary is 224 Street, and lots within 300 m of the escarpment crest require a geotechnical report attached to a Section 219 covenant before a building permit. Which West Central lots are affected is per-parcel: UNVERIFIED.

BC strata block — applies in full to any strata lot here (including Sherwood Park / Maple Villas resales): Form B (SPA s. 59), provided within 7 days, max $35 plus up to 25¢/page; depreciation reports every five years for stratas with five or more lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022; only 55+ age bylaws valid (SPA ss. 123.1/123.2 + Reg 7.01, May 1, 2023 exemptions); a "45+" listing line is NOT a valid age bylaw. No West Central complex carries a verified 55+ bylaw — Maple Ridge has ZERO verified 55+ strata townhouses, and Fraser Glen/Dogwood Lane-style 55+ marketing is NOT a verified bylaw (neither complex is in this sub-area in any event).

ALR block — stated for completeness, governing no identified West Central ground: subdivision within the ALR requires Agricultural Land Commission approval, and ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Information Bulletin 09, s. 6; Strata Property Act, s. 239; Agricultural Land Commission Act, s. 21(1)). Residence caps: one principal residence per parcel, maximum 500 m²; a secondary suite only inside the principal residence; one additional residence capped at 90 m² on parcels of 40 ha or less and 186 m² on parcels over 40 ha. Farm class (BC Assessment) in full three-tier form: $2,500 of gross farm income at 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 plus 5% of the actual value of the area over 4 ha above that; $10,000 under 0.8 ha — applications by October 31. A flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR and none is asserted here.

LOUGHEED TRANSIT CORRIDOR — ADOPTED Jan 27, 2026 per the City record (correction carried): Bylaw 7781-2021 (third reading + adoption Jan 27, 2026; City news release Feb 4, 2026); the corridor ends at 221 Street. faq.q: How did West Central sell in September 2026?
faq.a: Slowly for houses: detached recorded 66 active listings, 2 solds and a 3% sales ratio — the lowest detached sales ratio of any Maple Ridge sub-area with a sale that month — while Condos & Townhomes recorded 78 listings, 10 solds and a 13% sales ratio (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).

The live page names Alouette Elementary (22155 Isaac Crescent), Glenwood Elementary (21410 Glenwood Avenue), Laity View Elementary (21023 123 Avenue), Maple Ridge Secondary (21911 122 Avenue) and Westview Secondary (20905 Wicklund Avenue), with names and addresses confirmed against the BC Ministry K-12 school file; catchments are address-specific — check any address in the SD42 School Locator.

faq.q: What plans shape West Central's future?
faq.a: The adopted Lougheed Transit Corridor Area Plan directs growth around future Bus Rapid Transit stations along Lougheed Highway and Dewdney Trunk Road, the Town Centre Area Plan covers the downtown core at the east edge, and TransLink's Langley–Haney Place BRT is in detailed planning.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in West Central?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 66 houses listed with 2 sold in the month and 78 condos and townhomes listed with 10 sold in the month in West Central. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is West Central a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 3%, a buyers’ market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 13%, a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: Can I buy a bare building lot in West Central?
faq.a: There is no lot product to buy — no named bare-land subdivision, bare-land strata or presale lot offering exists here. What trades is built fee-simple house lots and strata units in existing complexes.

faq.q: Are Sherwood Park and Maple Villas land I can buy as lots?
faq.a: A purchase there is a strata-lot purchase with fees, bylaws and a Form B, not a vacant-land purchase; the title wording "freehold strata" is UNCONFIRMED in-entry and the strata plan governs.

faq.q: What is the smallest lot I can create by subdividing an RS-1 property?
faq.a: The RS-1 minimums are 668.0 m² area, 18.0 m width and 27.0 m depth (Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019 s. 605) — both the parent-lot remainder and any new lot must meet them.

faq.q: Does the Lougheed corridor plan change what my lot is worth?
faq.a: The corridor plan IS adopted (Jan 27, 2026, Bylaw 7781-2021, ending at 221 St), so its designations are settled policy — but a designation is not a rezoning approval for a specific parcel. Check the parcel's current designation in the City's document before pricing corridor upside into it.

faq.q: Can a house lot carry a suite or more units?
faq.a: One secondary suite per lot inside the house (maximum 40% of gross floor area, not in the floodplain), and eligible lots may add up to three, four or six SSMUH units — run both paths before listing an older house on a full-size RS-1 lot.

faq.q: Is there a bare-land market in West Central?
faq.a: No meaningful one: this is an established-residential sub-area — land trades as built RS-1 fee-simple house lots and strata lots under existing complexes, plus corridor-edge holds under the adopted Lougheed plan, not as vacant subdivision lots.

faq.q: What plans shape a West Central lot's value?
faq.a: A designation is not an approval — check the parcel's designation with the City before valuing it as a plain house lot.

faq.q: Can a West Central house lot have a suite or more units?
faq.a: One secondary suite per lot inside the house (maximum 40% of gross floor area, not in the floodplain area); eligible lots may also have up to three, four or six units under the City's SSMUH bylaws — run both paths before listing an older house on a full-size RS-1 lot.

faq.q: Can I buy an acreage in West Central?
faq.a: No — not on any source checked. West Central is established RS-1 house ground and existing strata complexes: no named acreage subdivision, no bare-land strata acreage community, no farm parcel product and no presale acreage offering was verified, and no ALR land in West Central was identified in the official sources checked. Verified named acreage developments here: 0.
